title: Glass Canon - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Glass Canon in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Visages - Sadness Vale, defeat the Chromatic Ramasseur

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Glass Canon is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: 50% increased damage dealt, but any damage taken removes the effect.

sections.title: Effect
sections.content: 50% increased damage dealt, but any damage taken removes the effect.

sections.title: How to Get Glass Canon
sections.content: Location: Visages - Sadness Vale, defeat the Chromatic Ramasseur.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
